acip: SUM CU RTZA GSUM DANG RGYAL CHEN RIGS BZHI'I LHA RNAMS LA DBANG PO GNYIS SBYOR GYI BDE BA YOD KYANG RLUNG 'DU 'PHROD KYI BDE BA TZAM LAS RTZA DANG KHAMS DKAR DMAR MED PAS DE'I BDE BA MED, YI DVAGS DANG DUD 'GRO LA DBANG PO GNYIS SBYOR GYI BDE BA YOD KYKANG LAS KYI SGRIB PA CHE ZHING DBANG PO RTUL BAS BDE BA LAM DU BYED MI NUS LA,
wylie: sum cu rtsa gsum dang rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i lha rnams la dbang po gnyis sbyor gyi bde ba yod kyang rlung 'du 'phrod kyi bde ba tsam las rtsa dang khams dkar dmar med pas de'i bde ba med, yi dvags dang dud 'gro la dbang po gnyis sbyor gyi bde ba yod kykang las kyi sgrib pa che zhing dbang po rtul bas bde ba lam du byed mi nus la
english: The gods of the Thirty-Three, and the Four Great Kings, do experience the bliss of joining the two organs, but as nothing more than the pleasure of the joining and mixing of the winds.  They do not get the experience of bliss that comes from channels, and the red and white elements, because they do not possess any of these inner parts.  Craving spirits and animals do possess the pleasure of union of the organs, but they have very bad obstacles caused by their past karma and are spiritually very stupid, and thus they are incapable of making this bliss a path.
